description: Audit any public online store for AI and agent readiness. Takes the store homepage URL and returns a 0-100 score with concrete findings: whether AI crawlers are allowed in robots.txt, whether the pages send their content in the HTML or only build it in the browser with JavaScript (React, Vue or Angular apps that most AI crawlers see as empty), whether product structured data is present, sitemap, llms.txt and HTTPS. Use this when asked whether a shop can be discovered, read or cited by AI shopping assistants such as ChatGPT, Perplexity or Google AI Overviews, or when reviewing a store's AI visibility. Works on any store on the public web - no account, no ownership and no login required.

url.description: The store homepage URL, e.g. "https://example.com". A product or category URL also works; the analyzer resolves the site root from it.

name: check_store_readiness
title: Check store AI readiness
